mission: Help families and everyday people stay powered, prepared, safe, and connected when normal systems fail.
vision: Become the most trusted personal power preparedness brand in homes, backpacks, glove boxes, and emergency kits.

origin_story.spark: A severe winter storm left the founder's home without power and exposed how unprepared families can feel in crisis.
origin_story.problem: When outages hit, people often have no practical backup plan for communication, lighting, and critical devices.
origin_story.why_it_matters: Power is not just convenience. It is safety, connection, and control during uncertain moments.
origin_story.founder_position: Founder-built with commitment, sacrifice, and direct empathy for families facing outages.

tone_rules: Lead with a real-life risk or customer moment.
Translate technical specs into plain-language outcomes.
Sound human and committed, never generic.
Close with one clear, low-friction next step.

business_profile.positioning: Preparedness-first portable power brand for families, travelers, outdoor users, students, and small business operators.
what_we_sell: Portable charging and backup power devices
what_we_do_not_position_as: Commodity gadget-only brand without preparedness guidance
differentiation: Product-fit guidance instead of one-size-fits-all selling
Outcome-focused education for real emergency scenarios
Trust built through practical coaching and clear next steps

audience_segments: Campers, adventurers, RV and van-life users
Seniors and caregivers who prioritize continuity and safety

immediate_value: Know exactly what to power first
Reduce panic with a clear action plan
Get practical product recommendations matched to daily needs
short_term_value: Fewer wrong purchases and less guesswork
More confidence for family safety and communication
long_term_value: Improve resilience across weather and grid uncertainty
Protect routines, productivity, and peace of mind over time
family_impact: Keeps loved ones connected during outages
Replaces helplessness with control and reassurance
lifestyle_shift: From reactive scrambling to proactive preparedness
From buying by hype to buying by fit
From uncertainty to confident energy planning

approved_sales_verbiage.hero_line: When the lights go out, your family should not be left in the dark.
core_phrases: Built for outages, travel, and everyday resilience
approved_sales_verbiage.trust_close: We do not just sell products. We help people stay calm, connected, and prepared when it matters most.

guardrails.allowed_solar_context: portable/foldable solar panels paired with portable power products
disallowed_claim_patterns: Pricing or margin claims unless explicitly provided from approved source
guardrails.compliance_note: All claims must map to published product specs, verified use-cases, or support policy.
